en: What if our universe comes with a self-destruct button to eliminate itself so cleanly and efficiently,
zh: 如果我們的宇宙帶有自我毀滅的按鈕去消除自己乾淨又有效率的

en: that every single physical thing would just stop existing and life would be impossible forever.
zh: 然後每個物理事物將消失的一乾二淨生命也將變為不可能直到永遠

en: The ultimate ecological catastrophe - vacuum decay.
zh: 這個極端的宇宙浩劫稱為"真空衰減"

en: (Theme music)
zh: （主題音樂）

en: To explain how our universe could destroy itself, we need to understand two principles:
zh: 為了解釋我們的宇宙如何自我毀滅我們必須了解兩個原則

en: One - energy levels.
zh: 1.能階(能量階級)

en: A core idea in physics is that everything has an energy level.
zh: 物理有個核心思想就是所有的事物都有能階

en: The higher the level, the more energy is in the system Wood, for example, has a high level.
zh: 能階越高能量越多舉個例子-"木頭"有很高的能階

en: It can be burnt, a process that releases the chemical energy stored in its molecular bonds and turns it into heat.
zh: 它可以被燒掉這是一個可以釋放分子鏈裡面化學能的過程然後轉化為"熱"

en: The ash leftover is at a lower energy level than the wood before.
zh: 而剩下的灰燼與先前的木頭相較之下能階較低

en: Two - stability.
zh: 2.穩定性

en: Everything in our universe tries to move towards its ground state, in which it's completely stable
zh: 所有的事物都試著趨向他的基態(基本狀態) 相較至下基態是完全穩定的

en: and has as little energy as possible.
zh: 而且能量越少越好

en: For example, a ball on a hill is unstable and has a lot of potential energy.
zh: 舉例來說，一顆在山丘上的球是不穩定的並且擁有很多的位能。

en: When disturbed, it will roll down into the valey and lose its potential energy in the process
zh: 當它受到擾動時，會滾到低谷並在過程中失去它的位能

en: The ball is now in its ground state and stable.
zh: 這顆球現在穩定地處於基態

en: It will remain like that.
zh: 而且會持續地保持這樣

en: Everything in our universe follows these two principles.
zh: 在我們宇宙的所有事物都遵守這兩個原則

en: If something has a lot of energy, it's unstable and wants to get rid of it to become stable and reach its ground state.
zh: 如果某個東西有很多能量它就會不穩定而且想要擺脫它(能量) 去變得穩定並達到它的基態

en: This is true for every system even in the weird world of quantum mechanics.
zh: 這適用於所有的事物即使是在一個詭異的世界-- "量子力學"

en: If our current understanding of physics is correct, then the universe gets its properties from quantum fields.
zh: 如果我們目前物理學的理解是正確的，那麼宇宙將從量子場得到它的屬性

en: We explained them in detail in another video.
zh: 我們已經在另一個影片詳細的解釋了它們

en: For this video, imagine them as the rules of the universe.
zh: 在這段影片，想像它們是宇宙的規則

en: They tell particles how to behave and interact Like everything in the universe,
zh: 他們告訴粒子如何表現和互動就像宇宙中的一切

en: they want to be in the lowest energy level possible, which is called a vacuum state.
zh: 他們儘可能保持在最低能階這就是所謂的真空狀態

en: This has nothing to do with vacuum in space.
zh: 這與空間的真空沒有關係

en: It's just called this way because scientists are bad at naming things We then call the fields reached their
zh: 它只是被這樣稱呼因為科學家不擅於為事物命名我們認為場已經達到了它們的

en: vacuum state, except maybe one.
zh: 真空狀態，但也許有一個例外

en: It's possible that the Higgs Field is not stable, but metastable, which is a fancy way of saying that it
zh: 希格斯場有可能處於不穩定但處於"介穩" 若以特別的方式表達，就是它

en: pretends to be stable but really is not.
zh: 假裝是穩定的，但實際上不是

en: It would be a false vacuum.
zh: 它是一種假真空

en: The Higgs Field is responsible for giving particles their mass, which rules how almost everything in the universe interacts.
zh: 希格斯場的功能是賦予粒子質量它幾乎掌管著在宇宙中所有事物的交互作用

en: What would happen if the Higgs Field is a false vacuum?
zh: 如果希格斯場不是假真空會發生什麼事？

en: Think of our ball in the valley: the ball is the Higgs Field.
zh: 讓我們想想剛剛在低谷的球球是希格斯場

en: The valley might not be the lowest energy state for the Higgs Field.
zh: 這個山谷可能不是希格斯場的最低能量狀態。

en: There might an even deeper valley that it wants to get to.
zh: 那裡可能有著它想趨向的更深的山谷

en: This would mean that the Higgs Field has a lot of potential energy, waiting to be released.
zh: 這意味著，希格斯場其實有很多位能等待被釋放

en: The Higgs Field could be like a piece of wood but drenched in gasoline, waiting to set the universe on fire.
zh: 希格斯場也像一塊淋滿了汽油的木頭等著燒了整個宇宙

en: A random spark like quantum tunneling could release the potential energy of the Higgs Fields.
zh: 量子穿隧就像隨機的火花可以釋放希格斯場的位能

notes.example: Participants were assigned to groups at random.

en: This could happen at any time and without warning.
zh: 這可能發生在任何時間沒有任何警告

en: If at any point in space, this so-called vacuum decay starts, there is no turning back.
zh: 如果在空間中的任何點這個所謂的真空衰減開始發生就沒有回頭路可走

en: As the Higgs Field crashes into the lower energy state, it releases a massive amount of potential energy.
zh: 當希格斯場崩塌至較低的能量狀態它將釋放巨量的位能

en: This energy pushes the space around it over the barrier, which releases more potential energy.
zh: 這種能量能推動它周圍的空間越過能階的障礙釋放出更多位能

en: A sphere of the new stable Higgs Field, or true vacuum, grows at the speed of light in all directions.
zh: 一個新的穩定希格斯場的領域或稱作真實真空將會以光速往各個方向擴張

en: Imagine it like setting a sea of gasoline, the size of the universe, on fire.
zh: 想像一下，它就像以汽油填滿的海洋等同宇宙的大小，而且著火了

en: This sphere is surrounded by a shell of energy that devours everything it comes into contact with.
zh: 這個領域被能量的外殼包圍，吞食一切和它接觸的事物

en: Whatever it touches is eliminated for existence.
zh: 無論它碰觸到什麼這個事物的存在都會被消除

en: The bubble will continue to grow forever.
zh: 而這個泡泡將繼續永遠增長

en: deleting the universe on its way.
zh: 並消除它經過的宇宙

en: There is no way to be warned, since it's so fast.
zh: 這件事無法被預測因為它是如此之快

en: But there's nothing we can do anyway.
zh: 而且反正我們也沒有什麼可以做的

en: Our destruction would be instant, in a fraction of second, Earth would be gone.
zh: 我們的毀滅將是瞬間的事在不到一秒的時間內地球就會消失

notes.zh: just need a second：請稍等我們一下
notes.example: Sorry, we just need a second to check the menu.

en: But it actually gets worse. If the energy level of the Higgs Field changes, it changes all of physics.
zh: 實際上它將變得更糟如果希格斯場的能階發生了變化它將改變所有的物理定律

notes.example: Actually, we're just looking around for now.

en: In the true vacuum of the sphere, the standard model will be overthrown, superseded by different physics that we don't know -
zh: 在領域的真實真空內標準模型將被推翻由我們不知道的不同的物理定律取代

en: how fundamental particles behave, how atoms hold together, how chemicals react.
zh: 基本粒子會如何表現原子會如何連結在一起化學物質會如何反應

notes.example: Are you sure that shelf can hold all these books?

notes.zh: come together：順利成形、水到渠成
notes.example: Everything came together right before the deadline.

en: Vacuum decay won't just destroy life, it will destroy chemistry itself, making life as we know it impossible.
zh: 真空衰減不只是毀滅生命它將會破壞化學本身使生活變成我們認為不可能的那種模樣

en: We simply have no idea what it would be like inside.
zh: 我們根本沒有任何想法它在裡面會是什麼樣子

en: It might be a shadow of what it is now, or not.
zh: 它可能會是它現在狀態的影子又或者不是

en: We don't know. If vacuum decay happens, the outlook is indeed grim.
zh: 我們並不知道如果真空衰減發生了前景確實嚴峻

en: If you feel slightly worried now, don't be.
zh: 如果你現在略感擔心其實不必這樣

en: At this point, false vacuum is speculation based on our current understanding of particle physics, which might be wrong.
zh: 其實不必這樣在這一點上，假真空是根據我們目前對於粒子物理學的理解所推測出來的，這表示它可能是錯的

notes.zh: don't take this the wrong way：別誤會我的意思（說真話前超實用緩衝句）
notes.example: Don't take this the wrong way, but the second version reads better.

en: It's kind of like using a ruler to measure a continent.
zh: 這有點像用尺去衡量一塊大陸

en: (playful music) Sure, you can do it, but you might be off by quite a bit at the end.
zh: （俏皮音樂）三年後當然，你可以做到，但你可能在最後會以一點點的誤差失敗

en: Right now, no-one can say a vacuum decay is a thing that's real or just a scary idea.
zh: 現在，沒有人能說真空衰減是真實的事情或者只是一個可怕的想法

en: But even if one or multiple spheres of death have already started expanding, the universe is so big that they might not reach us
zh: 但是，即使一個或多個死亡的領域已經開始擴張宇宙是如此之大他們或許在數十億年之內

en: for billions of years.
zh: 都不能到達我們所在

en: If they're far enough away, they might not ever be able to reach us because of the expansion of the universe.
zh: 如果他們夠遠他們可能永遠都不能達到我們這裡因為宇宙的膨脹

en: The speed of light is not that fast on the scale of the universe.
zh: 光速在宇宙的規模之中其實並不快

en: So, while vacuum decay is fascinatingly scary, right now, there are other things we should be more afraid of.
zh: 所以，雖然真空衰減是如此讓人著迷地可怕但目前，還有其他東西讓我們應該更害怕

en: In contrast to vacuum decay, we have the power to prepare for most of them.
zh: 與真空衰減相比之下我們其實有能力為他們的絕大部分做好準備

en: Videos like this one take hundreds of hours to make, so support us on Patreon if you'd like to learn more about
zh: 像這樣的影片需要幾百個小時去製作所以請在Patreon上支持我們如果您想了解更多

en: the destruction of everything.
zh: 有關一切事物的破壞

en: It really helps us out.
zh: 這確實能幫助我們

en: We tried to destroy the universe at least once every few months.
zh: 我們試圖摧毀宇宙至少每幾個月一次

en: So let us know in the comments, if you have doomsday scenarios you would like us to cover.
zh: 因此，在留言裡讓我們知道如果你有末日景象您會想要我們去掩蓋英文字幕由Amara.org社群提供

en: Subtitles by the Amara.org community
zh: 英文字幕由Amara.org社群提供
